open_points.subject: flow:administer_staff_accounts — assign_staff_project after revocation
open_points.text: State 4 says “after its revocation, refused by State 1's one-record-per-pair rule (persistence conflict, 500)”, while M07 says “assigning the pair again creates a new assignment record.”
open_points.question: After the active assignment is revoked, must assign_staff_project create a fresh active assignment or fail with 500?
options: Create a new active assignment record and preserve the revoked record
Refuse the reassignment with a persistence conflict (500)
open_points.default_guess: Create a new active assignment record and preserve the revoked record.

witness.initial: An existing staff/project assignment is active.
events: An administrator revokes the active assignment.
The administrator assigns the same staff account to the same active project again.
outcomes: M07 and INV-009 require a fresh active assignment while the revoked assignment remains unchanged.
State 4 reports a persistence conflict (500) and creates nothing.
witness.observer: The administrator sees either a successful assignment record or HTTP 500; subsequent operator authorization also differs.

open_points.subject: flow:administer_viewer_access — grant_viewer_project after revocation
open_points.text: State 4 says “after its revocation, refused by State 1's one-record-per-pair rule (persistence conflict, 500)”, while M04 says “giving the pair access again creates a new grant record.”
open_points.question: After the active viewer grant is revoked, must grant_viewer_project create a fresh active grant or fail with 500?
options: Create a new active grant and preserve the revoked grant
Refuse the new grant with a persistence conflict (500)
open_points.default_guess: Create a new active grant and preserve the revoked grant.

witness.initial: A viewer has an active grant for an active project.
events: An administrator revokes the active grant.
The administrator grants the same viewer access to the same project again.
outcomes: M04 and INV-009 require a fresh active grant while the revoked grant remains unchanged.
State 4 reports a persistence conflict (500) and creates nothing.
witness.observer: The administrator sees either a successful grant or HTTP 500; the viewer subsequently either can or cannot read the project.

open_points.subject: flow:administer_service_principals — duplicate active producer grant
open_points.text: “capability:service_identity.grant_producer_project requires the project known and active (capability:registry_gateway.validate_project_reference) and appends producer_grant.create” and the Errors section states no outcome when the pair already has an active grant.
open_points.question: What declared failure and HTTP status does grant_producer_project produce when an active grant already exists for the principal/project pair?
options: Reject in the operation before writing, as an authorization rejection (403)
Let the partial unique constraint reject it as a persistence failure (500)
open_points.default_guess: Reject in the operation before writing with 403, matching the staff-assignment and viewer-grant flows.

witness.initial: A granted-projects service principal already has an active grant for an active project.
events: An administrator requests another grant for the same principal/project pair.
outcomes: The operation detects the active grant and returns 403 without writing.
The insert reaches storage and the partial unique constraint produces a persistence failure (500), without writing.
witness.observer: The administrator sees a different HTTP status and failure classification.
